release_label: EES Gemini v0.9.2 engineering completion candidate
approval_scope: Engineering candidate validated locally; GA remains blocked pending a real npm lockfile, Playwright and clean Docker CI, resolved dependency audits/SBOM, full-history secret scan, Trivy container CVE triage, immutable Docker base digest pin, live Gemini verification, and independent security review.
changes: Added external-skill intake and provenance policy
Added evidence-based incumbent-versus-candidate scorecard with non-compensable license and security gates
Added MERGE_UPGRADE / ADD_DISTINCT_SKILL / KEEP_EXISTING / QUARANTINE / REJECT decisions
Added canonical placement rules, negative-trigger routing checks, regression and rollback requirements
Added intake decision template, JSON Schema, Arabic and English README notes, and focused policy tests
Added domain-specific blind-spot traps and hard invariants to all 32 canonical skills
Added native Google GenAI SDK adapter and optional dependency manifest
Added Node.js and Playwright operational fixtures plus multilingual fixture runner
Added end-to-end task-runtime lifecycle, invalid-transition, and concurrent-read tests
Archived historical release reports and created a single current validation report
Fixed fixture-count regression to derive the expected fixture count dynamically.
Hardened subprocess test helpers to kill process groups on timeout, preventing descendant processes from holding test pipes open.
Added real npm lockfile bootstrap and a manual CI workflow to resolve and preserve a reviewed lockfile artifact.
Added release assurance CI gates for browser tests, dependency audits, resolved-environment SBOMs, full-history secret scanning, Docker build, and live Gemini smoke verification.
Added local secret-entropy scanner and an explicitly partial manifest SBOM; no synthetic lockfile or release-grade claim is made.
